body:
Source: repo bloat review (tools over-engineering review). CONVENTIONS.md Rule 2 requires shared helpers to live in `@adlc/core`. `tokenizeCommand` is currently implemented identically in `packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs` and `packages/review-calibration/lib/runner.mjs`. Promoting it into `@adlc/core` eliminates the duplicated code and establishes a single canonical tokenizer.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `packages/core/lib/cli.mjs`: implement and export `tokenizeCommand(template)`.
2. In `packages/core/index.mjs` and `packages/core/index.d.ts`: export `tokenizeCommand`.
3. Add unit test `packages/core/test/helpers-promotion-batch2.test.mjs` verifying command tokenization with single/double quotes and whitespace.
4. In `packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs`: import `tokenizeCommand` from `@adlc/core` and remove the local function.
5. In `packages/review-calibration/lib/runner.mjs`: import `tokenizeCommand` from `@adlc/core` and remove the local function.
6. Ensure all unit tests pass across `@adlc/core`, `@adlc/model-ratchet`, and `@adlc/review-calibration`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 `tokenizeCommand` is exported from `@adlc/core` with type declarations in `index.d.ts`.
- AC2 `packages/core/test/helpers-promotion-batch2.test.mjs` passes green.
- AC3 `grep -n 'function tokenizeCommand' packages/model-ratchet/lib/run-review.mjs packages/review-calibration/lib/runner.mjs` returns nothing.
- AC4 `npm test -w packages/core && npm test -w packages/model-ratchet && npm test -w packages/review-calibration` exits 0.
- AC5 `adlc rails-guard` and `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exit 0.
title: refactor(core): promote tokenizeCommand helper into @adlc/core
